title: Accuracy Is Not Evidence: Measuring and Training Evidence Dependence in Video Temporal Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2611.30320v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In video temporal grounding, a correct interval can come from finding the event, answering blind or fitting one annotation style, and Recall at IoU scores them alike. We measure evidence dependence, how much the answer rests on the event's frames. Our fixed-answer audit edits either the frames inside the annotated interval or, as a placebo, as many frames elsewhere in the same video, and compares the two drops in the annotated answer's likelihood. Supervised fine-tuning and three public checkpoints trained with IoU-reward reinforcement learning raise the accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 9 to 20 points, partly by answering blind and by fitting one annotation. Yet their answers rest on the event no more than the base model's, and the same holds for IoU-reward training on our data at the audit's frame rate. This comparison is a difference of the model's own likelihoods, so we can train on it. A placebo contrast and a bound on the placebo drop

translated_title: 准确率并非证据：视频时序定位中证据依赖性的测量与训练
translated_abstract: 在视频时序定位任务中，一个正确的区间可能来自真正定位到事件、盲目作答，或拟合了某种标注风格，而基于IoU的Recall指标对这几种情况一视同仁。我们测量证据依赖性，即答案在多大程度上依赖于事件所在的帧。我们的固定答案审计方法要么编辑标注区间内的帧，要么（作为安慰剂对照）编辑同一视频中其他位置相同数量的帧，并比较这两种情况下标注答案似然值的下降幅度。监督微调以及三个使用IoU奖励强化学习训练的公开模型检查点，将Qwen2.5-VL-7B的准确率提升了9至20个百分点，部分原因是通过盲目作答和拟合某种标注实现的。然而，这些模型的答案对事件帧的依赖程度并不高于基础模型，在审计帧率下用我们的数据进行IoU奖励训练同样如此。由于这一比较是模型自身似然值之间的差值，因此我们可以将其用于训练。通过安慰剂对照和安慰剂下降的界限约束（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“证据依赖性”审计方法，揭示现有视频时序定位模型的准确率提升部分源于盲目作答而非真正依赖事件帧，并证明模型自身似然值的差值可作为训练信号来提升模型对事件证据的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an evidence-dependence audit revealing that accuracy gains in video temporal grounding partly come from blind answering rather than reliance on event frames, and demonstrates that the difference of a model's own likelihoods can serve as a training signal to improve evidence dependence.
